It stays below ~0.85 when the preposition is lexically governed by the word before it ('interested in', 'depend(ent) on', 'rely on', 'believe in', 'faith in', 'listen to', 'look at', 'because of', 'resulted in', 'thought of', 'theory of'), and on content words (~0) and sentence-final '.' (~0.75); note the first token alone reads 0.6-0.85 for pronouns ('I', 'He', 'She', 'It', 'They', 'We') but 0.9-1.3 for 'The', 'Her', 'Please', 'Then' or an imperative verb ('Place', 'Store'), so a text opening that way is weakly active on that token.
